d:
Short, messy, chestnut brown hair with long bangs falling over the forehead. Large, wide-set, amber orange eyes with a timid expression. Appears to be a late adolescent with a soft, youthful face. Small, slender build. A cream-colored tunic under a brown sleeveless vest with a white scarf wrapped around the neck and a brown cloak draped over the shoulders. A small, brown leather pouch attached to the belt.
BODY COLOR: pale peach
